description: Browse the public proof-of-grind gallery: rare Solana addresses people have published with a verifiable grind receipt. Sort by rarity score or recency, filter by tier, minimum pattern length, or a substring the pattern must contain, and paginate. Each entry shows the address, pattern, rarity score/bits, tier, and an explorer link. Read-only.

contains.description: Only addresses whose vanity pattern contains this substring.

minLength.description: Only patterns at least this many characters long.

sort.description: Order by rarity score (rarest first) or recency. Default score.

tier.description: Filter to a single rarity tier id.

name: vanity_gallery
title: Browse the proof-of-grind rarity gallery
